why: The answer depends on the mechanism of cultural eutrophication: nutrient enrichment causes algal blooms whose microbial decay raises BOD and strips dissolved oxygen, so fish die of asphyxiation - a water-pollution fact absent from every chapter in the supplied list.
note: Taxonomy gap: expected the chapter 'Environmental Issues' (topic: water pollution / eutrophication and BOD). The supplied list has no pollution chapter at all; Ecosystem teaches decomposition and energy flow but not eutrophication, and Biodiversity and Conservation teaches causes of species loss, so forcing it into either would misfile it.
